title: Genesis USA - 2027 Electrified GV70 page
notes: 2027 Electrified GV70: 84 kWh battery (bare capacity, treated as gross), up to 350 kW on an 800V DC charger, 10-80 % in as few as 19 min, built-in NACS port, over 36,000 Tesla Superchargers plus up to 30,000 IONNA. No usable kWh, AC kW or battery conditioning stated.
